summary: The team is juggling urgent IT fixes, the knowledge website redesign, and a major push on Asia Star, Intelligent China, and Tech in Asia follow-up, with several deadlines this week.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most pressing issue is the Outlook account lockout, which requires immediate device-by-device password updates and coordination with JSB to confirm the backend unlock. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is advancing: Joseph must share the HTML design and the team needs to meet to finalise feedback on menu structure, article pages, and video integration. The global marketing strategy is ramping up, with priority on Asia Star and Intelligent China programs; Joseph is building the Intelligent China webpage with separate tabs, and the team must analyse participant profiles and set up conversion tracking. This week also demands progress on Tech in Asia follow-up: crafting and sending a single appreciation email with program info, creating touch points, and securing marcom support for editing and graphics. Looking ahead, the Women in Leadership Forum with UN Women and the CCG event require coordination, and the Berkeley program is being considered as a third overseas priority.
